Passively grants #e${30+#d} Inventory Size Stat. (For reference, running 1 or 2 Reserve mods grants 20 or 40 Inventory Size respectively)  

Being Airborne grants the following benefits:
• #e${30+#f} Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 15?% Decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 20?% Decreased Auto Aim Cone Size

var d = -30
var f = 5
